events.title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options
must_haves: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.

answer_sheet.Exact wording: Moss & Mile on every option, including the ampersand; no extra text.
answer_sheet.Number and delivery: Three separate square images, not one collage or contact sheet.
answer_sheet.Style and palette: Simple cycling-club logos using green and black on white.
answer_sheet.How different the options should be: Three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts, not just recolors of one design.

events.text:
I couldn't make the logos because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. All three requests were turned down, and so was one more try with the cheapest free-plan image model (about 5 credits per image). Nothing was created, and since every request was refused before it ran, you shouldn't have been charged.

These are the three ideas I sent. Each was set up as its own square image in green and black on white, using an image model that's good at text:

1. **Leaf wheel:** a simple black bicycle wheel with one green moss leaf growing from the centre, and "Moss & Mile" below in clean, bold black lettering.
2. **Winding road:** a black road curving up over a rounded green hill, with a small milestone post beside it, and "Moss & Mile" in elegant black serif lettering.
3. **Fern ampersand:** an "&" shape made from a curling green fern, inside a thin black ring with teeth like a bike chain ring, and "Moss & Mile" below in modern black capitals.

To make them, you'll need more credits on the account. Free credits may refill on a schedule, or you can buy a credit pack or upgrade. Then tell me and I'll run all three. The cheaper model would cost about 15 credits for the set, and the one that handles text better about 30. If you'd like to change any of the symbols first, just say.

events.why: The reply says no logos were made because the account lacks credits, and the user needs to add credits or upgrade before anything can run. It ends by offering to proceed, but the main message is an inability caused by the account's plan and credit balance.
